title: House of H. Khadijah (s.a.)
introduction:
HOUSE OF H. KHADIJAH (S.A.)

The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and the mother of faithful, Khadijah (s.a.) used to live in this house. The daughter of Khadijah (s.a.), Fatima Zahra (s.a.) was also born in this house. The demise of H. Khadijah (s.a.) occured in this very house. It was the residence of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) before Hijrat (migration to Medina). Jibraeel, the trustworthy one, has also descended here a few times. The dome of revelation (Qubba-e-Wahy) is in it. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) used to supplicate to Allah in this house. The disbelievers of Quraysh hatched a plot to kill him here. H. Ali (a) slept on the bed of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and prepared to sacrifice his life in the way of Allah in this very house. The people going for the Ziyarat of Baytullahul Haraam should recite the following supplication at the house of Khadijah (s.a.):

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ بِالْبِضْعَۃِ الزَّهْرَآئِ وَ اَوْلَادِهَا الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَیْنِ عَلَیْهِمَا السَّلَامُ یَسِّرْ اُمُوْرَنَا وَ اشْرَحْ صُدُوْرَنَا وَ اخْتِمْ بِالصَّالِحَاتِ اَعْمَالَنَا اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَوْدَعْتُ فِیْ هٰذَا الْمَحَلِّ الشَّرِیْفِ مِنْ یَوْمِنَا هٰذَا اِلٰی یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَۃِ اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اﷲُ وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَ رَسُوْلُهٗ۔
